profile.description: POWER-VAC cleans gutters across Norwich and Norfolk from the ground, with a SkyVac gutter vacuum on a long pole. No ladders against your walls and no mess on your lawn: everything goes into the vacuum. A camera on the pole shows the inside of your gutters while we work, and you get before and after photos when we are done. Three-storey town houses and blocks of flats are no problem. We also unblock downpipes, clean fascias and soffits, remove roof moss and power wash driveways and patios. Fully insured, local and reliable, with gutter cleaning from £34.99. We cover Norwich, Wymondham, Attleborough, Dereham, Thetford, Aylsham and the villages around them. Ring for a free, no-obligation quote.
